verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a REST API that can read people (with field selection, custom-field filtering and sorting) and write records (sending leads/events, attachments, text logs). It also offers webhooks for event notifications, which give a basis for change detection and two-way sync. However, nothing in the pack documents rate limits, a true upsert/dedupe-on-write contract (only a 'check whether a person exists' call), incremental/updated-since querying, or behavior at scale. missing for 10: documented rate limits, explicit upsert semantics, incremental change-detection queries, at-scale sync guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
Use webhooks to be notified about events that happen in a Follow Up Boss account.
Send in a lead or an event related to a lead.
Check whether a person exists in Follow Up Boss.
